subject: Demo: calendar organizer & guest join permissions
body:
From: Alicia Green <alicia.green@finweb.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@finweb.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo & calendar access for guest presenters

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for offering the demo next Tuesday. We have two engineers who need presenter privileges (to share screens and start recording) but when I accepted the calendar invite the Zoom join button is missing and the attached ICS shows Organizer as my personal calendar (personal@finweb.com). Can you confirm whether Redwood sent the invite from an organizational organizer or if it was created by our side?

Also attaching a short agenda. Can you update the invite so our engineers are hosts or give us an alternative link we can use?

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Green
Head of Integrations, FinWeb Analytics

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Green <alicia.green@finweb.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & calendar access for guest presenters

Hi Alicia,

Sorry for the trouble — quick summary from our side: the calendar invite was initially created in your tenant (it shows your address as organizer), so the Zoom host token is tied to that organizer. That explains why the Zoom "Join" button disappears for guests who aren't listed as co-hosts.

Two fixes:
1) We can re-send the invite from our account so the organizer is meetings@redwood.com (preferred, keeps host controls consistent).
2) Or, if you prefer to keep it on your calendar, you can make one of your engineers a host/co-host in Zoom and transfer organizer rights to our meetings account afterward.

Ben and Monica, can you confirm whether we should recreate the invite from meetings@redwood.com or request an organizer transfer? If we recreate, I'll include the Agenda_v3 and SOW draft.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & calendar access for guest presenters

Vanessa — recreate from meetings@redwood.com. If we keep it on their calendar we risk last-minute host issues. I can spin up a secondary Zoom link as a fallback and send a Bridge token, but that adds friction. Let's just reissue the invite from our organizer and add Alicia and Michael as optional presenters.

Monica, once invite is recreated, please set co-host permissions for both engineers and include the recording policy in the notes (they asked about recording).

Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Green <alicia.green@finweb.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & calendar access for guest presenters

Hi Alicia — quick instructions if you prefer to transfer organizer instead of us recreating:

1) In Google Calendar, open the event -> More actions -> Email guests.
2) Click the three-dot menu on the event and choose Change owner.
3) Add meetings@redwood.com as the new owner and save (it forwards an ownership request to us).

If you do that, your side will still control attendee management but the Zoom host token will be bound to meetings@redwood.com and guests will see the Join button. If you're comfortable with us recreating the event we will:
- Create a new event from meetings@redwood.com
- Attach Agenda_v3.pdf and SOW-draft-FinWeb.pdf
- Set both engineers as co-hosts and include recording policy in the description

Let me know which path you prefer and we'll action immediately.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success | Redwood Inference

---

From: Alicia Green <alicia.green@finweb.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & calendar access for guest presenters

Thanks all — we'll transfer ownership to meetings@redwood.com now (we want to keep the event on our calendar for audit reasons). I'll ping when it's done.

— Alicia

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Green <alicia.green@finweb.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & calendar access for guest presenters

Perfect — Alicia, thanks for doing that. Once ownership transfer completes, please forward us the acceptance/confirmation email (Google sends a small note). We'll: 
- Confirm Zoom Join button appears for guests
- Add both engineers as co-hosts and share the alternate host link as a fallback
- Update the event description with our recording policy and attendee checklist

Attaching updated Agenda_v3.pdf and SOW-draft-FinWeb.pdf here for your records. Also linking the HubSpot deal and DocuSign preview for legal.

If anything breaks during the transfer, Ben will post a fallback Zoom link in the thread within 15 minutes.

Talk soon,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Agenda_v3.pdf (application/pdf), SOW-draft-FinWeb.pdf (application/pdf)
